items.title: Immutable Evidence
items.instruction: Treat package files and metadata as immutable evidence.

items.title: Detect Destination
items.instruction: Detect the destination engine, version, and render pipeline.

items.title: Avoid Support Claims
items.instruction: Do not claim support from detection alone.

items.title: Draft Import Plan
items.instruction: Write import_plan.json before copying or modifying files.

items.title: Report Reconstruction
items.instruction: Report axis, units, pivot, hierarchy, materials, textures, LOD, and colliders.

items.title: Map Portable Channels
items.instruction: Plan destination channel conversions without assuming Blender shader transfer.

items.title: Verify Uv0 Binding
items.instruction: Verify required_uv_set imports as TEXCOORD_0 and drives normal-map tangents.

items.title: Plan Lod Membership
items.instruction: Plan mutually exclusive LOD groups with only each group's LOD0 active by default.

items.title: Show Losses
items.instruction: Show expected files, transformations, and known losses to the user.

items.title: Request Approval
items.instruction: Obtain explicit user approval for the exact import plan.

items.title: Apply Approved Plan
items.instruction: Modify the destination only after approval and within the plan.

items.title: Write Receipt
items.instruction: Write import_receipt.json for all destination changes.

items.title: Validate Import
items.instruction: Write import_validation.json and report unresolved dependencies.

items.title: Honor Exclusions
items.instruction: Exclude rigs, animation, gameplay logic, and unapproved advanced shaders.
